names.marshall_field_jr_house_1919_prairie: 1919 Prairie Avenue — Marshall Field Jr. house, after its 1902 enlargement

source.citation: '(Former Mansion, Marshall Field, Jr.) Gatlin Institute, 1919 Prairie Avenue, Chicago', vignetted halftone in the Gatlin Institute advertisement 'Drug and Liquor Habits Quickly and Painlessly Cured', Cohen's Grand Opera House theatre programme, Chicago, 1919. Photographer uncredited.
what_it_does_not_supply: the south flank and the rear
the front's lower storeys: the parkway trees hide them
a 1904 date: the photograph is c. 1909-1919
what_it_supplies: the street hip's height: its front hip rises to about 15.9 m over the 9.5 m eave, about 52 degrees, through the solved camera
the street dormers: a broad gabled dormer of three lights over the front's north part and a smaller one-light dormer near its south end
the round tower's top: a flat top on a plain band over its third grade of windows, at about the height the built cone's tip stood
the north flank's stacks, tower and gables seen from the north-west
